description: This file contains the implementation of a specific command class 'DeleteAttributeLiveCommandImpl' for handling delete-attribute commands within an 'eclipse.ditto' project. It defines an immutable class that extends a base command class, providing methods to access command details and modify headers.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: Immutable implementation of 'DeleteAttributeLiveCommand', encapsulating delete attribute command details and behaviors.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from a Command object, casting it to DeleteAttribute.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the attribute to delete.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is 'DELETE'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with specified DittoHeaders, modifying headers related to the command.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization, returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for creating responses to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
